metadata.title: simple-ascii-chart
metadata.description: Simple ASCII Chart is a TypeScript library and CLI for rendering customizable ASCII charts in terminals, logs, API responses, and documentation.

footer.credit: Designed and built by Bartosz Gryta (gtktsc).

home.description: Create terminal-native TypeScript ASCII charts for CLIs, logs, API responses, dashboards, and developer documentation.
home.intro: Simple ASCII Chart is a lightweight and flexible TypeScript library for customizable ASCII charts directly in terminal output. It visualizes two-dimensional data, multiple series, colors, formatting, thresholds, legends, and axis labels.
home.useCases: Generate compact charts where graphical rendering is not available: command-line tools, build logs, API responses, diagnostics, and lightweight dashboards.
